Replace EVERY broad greatsword with ONE slender Japanese TACHI / KATANA per figure: long narrow single-edged steel blade with a restrained gentle curvature, dark gray spine and pale edge, small round brass tsuba guard, straight chestnut wrapped two-hand handle and tiny brass pommel. Blade width visibly MUCH narrower than the reference greatsword, recognizable as a Japanese curved sword. Brown scabbard attached at the left hip only if it fits cleanly without clutter. One sword per pose, natural two-hand grip. No second weapon, bow, extra limbs, glow or slash effects. Keep full costume coverage and same girl design. All complete figures, sword tips and tails stay in their own cells with ample transparent gutters; no touching adjacent poses.
